note: Both sets correctly capture the naming convention (211 = 21.1%, 241 = 24.1%), the Re = 10E+6 test condition, and the main polar readings, but Set A pads these with many redundant restatements of the same thickness facts and adds shaky graph reads (lift coefficient 0.0 at 0 deg, and a 'maximum' lift of 1.8 at ~15 deg for Mixed flow, when the plotted peak is ~1.9 at a higher angle). Set B is more economical, keeping the supported thickness/Re facts once and adding plausible negative-lift and negative-drag-ratio readings from the polar, though it does duplicate the L/D = 140 claim and gives two inconsistent lift values near 15 deg. Overall Set B contains fewer misread or unsupported claims while retaining the key facts.
